title: Work-tape head displacement bound
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be an input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For every $u\in\mathbb{N}$ and every work-tape index $j$, the head position on tape $j$ after $u$ steps lies in the integer interval from its initial position minus $u$ to its initial position plus $u$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: An input word and configuration on that input
